messages.subject: Line Production Modeling
parts:
Dear all, 

I want to create a model to simulate a line production repair area.

e.g.:

A entity are tested by a machine (in the picture Test 1), if this entity are NG, the same are segregated to a Repair area (this area can have several repairs stations, in the picture Repair 1 and Repair 2), to make repairs in the same. After this repair the entity return to main line to be inspect again (check the quality). If the entity is OK, continues to the next test machine up until the end of machine testings (Sink).





I´m studing the R-Simmer documentation, but if possible, I want "Start" to began write the script. 

In advance, in my model, I will need calculate the lead time and the throughput of the entities on several test conditions (I will consider, inpection times and rejection rates). 

Best regards... 

Leonardo

It depends on the specific details, but at first glance, it seems an
easy one to me. I would set up a series of seize>timeout>release for
the tests, and between tests, a branch would decide whether to repair
(just another seize>timeout>release) and rollback to the last test, or
to continue to the next one.

> In advance, in my model, I will need calculate the lead time and the
> throughput of the entities on several test conditions (I will consider,
> inpection times and rejection rates).

The output from get_mon_arrivals() includes a column called
"finished": if this flag is FALSE, it means that the arrival was
rejected. Complementarily, the output from
get_mon_arrivals(per_resource=TRUE) records the whole path, resource
by resource, for each arrival, so you can check where it was rejected.
